checkpoints.prompt: Confirm the Prolific study ID, all three default URL identifiers, disclosed administrative storage and same-browser resume with duplicate blocking.
Are these the correct distinct completion, screen-out, no-consent, withdrawal and technical-error paths and their Prolific processing actions?
Does this study use no screening, prescreener validation or custom screening, and have its eligibility and compensation rules been confirmed?
Did the actual Prolific draft Preview deliver identifiers, save a Test/Prolific response and return through the reviewed path?
Confirm disclosure of automatic answer deletion and minimal administrative retention; verify atomic erasure, refresh, CSV absence and duplicate blocking without deleting real responses.
Use a private expiring Test-only grant for repeated draft Preview. Preserve prior attempts and reject production, expired and wrong-study grants. Remove the grant before real collection.

Confirm the real participant-facing task, consent/contact, honest duration, participant count, reward, displayed total, completion review and separate Production URL. A Production Preview creates a Real-mode record.
If the provider pauses for routine review, preserve configuration and record the pending status separately. Stored answers alone cannot verify paid submission or payment.
Confirm who deletes answers, administrative identifiers and operator copies after the retention period; record the deadline after verification and never imply an unconfigured scheduled deletion.
